findings.description: The copyright line still reads "Copyright (c) 2026 claude-code-power-config contributors" — the pre-rename repo name. It's the only remaining `claude-code-power-config`/`power-config` reference anywhere in the tree (verified via repo-wide grep, excluding `.git/`). This PR (titled "rework the README's first screen for the rename") fixed every other instance (clone URL, `cd`, title) but left this one, and its own new License badge (README.md line 8) now links straight to this file, so a reader who clicks through lands on the stale name. Not part of the diff under review (LICENSE is untouched), so this is pre-existing rather than something the PR's own prose got wrong — flagging because the PR advertises itself as the rename's README follow-up and this is the one nearby miss.
